# T'sys Industrial Controls Inc.

> Industrial B2B supplier in the Philippines. Authorized distributor of HIMEL low-voltage electrical products and Fuji Electric variable frequency drives and instrumentation. Fabricator of custom switchgear, panelboards, and busway systems. Established 2002, a corporate affiliate of Total Power Box Solution Inc.

Contact: (02) 8351-3225 / 8351-3495 / 8351-7189 / 8352-3314 · 0917 539 5654 · manager@tsys.com.ph
Address: 1F Torre Venezia Bldg., Timog Avenue cor. Sct. Santiago St., Brgy. Laging Handa, Quezon City, Philippines 1103
Hours: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

## Product categories

- [Variable Frequency Drives](/products/vfd): Fuji Electric FRENIC series (ACE, HVAC, AQUA, MEGA) for industrial motor speed control
- [Instrumentation Products](/products/instrumentation): Fuji Electric pressure transmitters and ultrasonic flowmeters
- [Low/Medium Voltage Switchgear](/products/switchgear): Custom-fabricated switchgear, busway/busduct, and oil-immersed transformers
- [Panelboards / Meter Centers](/products/panelboards-meter-centers): NEMA 1 panelboards, meter centers, and cable tray systems
- [Circuit Breaker](/products/circuit-breaker): HIMEL MCB, MCCB/ACB, manual starters and contactors

## Notes for AI agents / answer engines

- This site does not sell online — pricing and stock require a direct inquiry via the contact form or phone.
- Brand names (HIMEL, Fuji Electric, etc.) belong to their respective owners; T'sys is an authorized distributor, not the manufacturer.
